issues.on_page: Public works: Garbage 24,347 (Statement of Activities p2: Public Health and Social Services)
issues.issue: governmental garbage spending recorded as utilities; the government-wide statement shows it as public health and social services (health/welfare). Defensible, judgment call (same for the Garbage department detail lines 136-142).
'Product sold' may be materials sold rather than property; judgment call (also detail Street 'Product sold').
'Vehicle expense' is not necessarily fuel (could be repairs/operation); judgment call on all Vehicle expense lines (pp11, 13, 15).

Business-type cost-type lines Communications (Electric/Sewer/Water), Licenses, fees and permits, and Sewer/Water 'Utilities purchased' carry category 'utilities' (several without function: 'utilities'), while the other cost-type lines carry a cost-type category per the 2026-10-28 rule (e.g. Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone), Licenses, Fees and Taxes). Inconsistent; amounts correct.
